value.rationale: The theorem solves a natural minimal topology perturbation of identical Kuramoto rings for every integer m≥4 and every chord strength: exact loss of twisted stability, four persistent stable symmetry-broken phase classes, a stable obtuse-chord (negative linear conductance) window and its sharp endpoint. This supplies an all-parameter analytic bifurcation benchmark and explains stable frustration beyond what generic finite numerical examples reveal.
